objectives: To synthesize and critically appraise the evidence on early-phase fluid biomarkers in acute ischemic stroke, stratify findings by clinically relevant therapeutic time windows, and identify the most promising protein, metabolite, and nucleic/ribonucleic-acid markers for rapid AIS diagnosis and stroke-mimic differentiation.
inclusion_criteria: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses including studies on fluid biomarkers used to differentiate ischemic stroke from stroke mimics or controls; fluid sampling <72 h; confirmatory MRI with diffusion sequences as the standard of truth; human subjects; articles in English, German, Dutch, Italian, French, Spanish, or Portuguese.
exclusion_criteria: Studies comparing ischemic stroke versus hemorrhagic stroke or controls; systematic reviews not reporting biomarker-level differences between AIS and stroke mimics; systematic reviews or meta-analyses without primary-study data; primary studies; narrative reviews; conference abstracts.
pmid_query: Research question from Supplementary material_Strings: Which fluid biomarkers can be useful for the diagnosis of ischemic stroke vs stroke mimics? MEDLINE/PubMed search: Stroke/Brain Ischemia/Brain Infarction MeSH or stroke/ischemic stroke/cerebral ischemia in title or abstract; AND biomarkers/blood/cerebrospinal-fluid terms plus an explicit biomarker list (including activins, adiponectin, bilirubin, BDNF, CRP, D-dimer, GFAP, HMGB1, ICAM-1, IL-6, MMP-9, microRNAs, BNP, neurofilament/NfL, NT-proBNP, S100B, selectins, tau, TNF-alpha, VCAM-1, vWF, and related terms); AND diagnosis/differential-diagnosis/detection terms; limits: inception to Sep 1, 2025; filters: systematic review, meta-analysis, human.
selection_evidence: Main Results state that 27 systematic reviews were included. Supplementary Table S2 explicitly enumerates 27 included review labels. Main-text numbered subsets are biochemistry [20-33], metabolomics [34], miRNA [15,21,35-40], circRNA [15,38,41], lncRNA [15,42], and cfDNA [15], but these numbered subsets do not resolve all 27 included reviews cleanly. Supplementary Tables S3, S5, S6, S8, S10, and S12 were therefore used to recover the full included-review set.
notes: Used study_entries because an all-inclusive exact ref-number list could not be recovered with confidence from the extracted main-manuscript references. Supplementary Table S2 lists 27 reviews, but several labels are absent or inconsistent in the extracted reference list: Anand 2005, Rahmig 2024, Ramos-Fernandez 2011, and the circRNA review labeled Zhang 2023. For matched items, bibliographic details come from the main reference list/RIS export; several supplement labels are off by one year versus the reference list (for example Dewdney 2017 vs ref 37 Dewdney 2018, Hasan 2011 vs ref 24 Hasan 2012, Huang 2023 vs ref 25 Huang 2024, Klokman 2023 vs ref 21 Klokman 2024). The Zhang 2023 circRNA entry is most plausibly ref 41 (Zhao et al. 2022), and that inference is reflected below.
